n: Light up soft toy with LilyPad
t: A lesson where students sew an LED circuit into a soft toy.
steps: Find the lesson sequence on the page named Light up soft toy with LilyPad.
Gather a LilyPad ProtoSnap kit, felt, needles, scissors, and an embroidery hoop.
Check that students have basic needle and thread skills.
Teach the learning hook and have students draw a circuit on the template.
Have students sew the circuit with conductive thread.
Test each toy and hold the demo and reflection.
For the follow-up, install the latest Arduino IDE on a Mac or PC.
